title: Degreewise finite basis coproduct for the ordered negative Koszul tensor
statement: For a positive-length ordered negative Koszul tensor, in each integer degree n the supported pure basis maps indexed by subsets I with n=-|I| form a coproduct of the tensor unit.

theorem isColimit_ringedNegativeKoszulBasis_succ
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (r : ℕ)
    (b : Fin (r + 1) → (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk
      ((ringedNegativeKoszul O (r + 1) b m).X n)
      (fun I : {I : Finset (Fin (r + 1)) // n = -(I.card : ℤ)} ↦
        ringedNegativeKoszulBasis O (r + 1) b m I.1 n)))
